contract.sign: sign(facing dot (oriented projected over tangent cross under tangent)); positive facing depth is over. Guides oriented first to last.
contract.ownership: At a crossing vertex choose the outgoing segment with t=0; deduplicate incoming t=1 by station. Crossing requires four alternating local rays.
contract.marks: Each @over point must match exactly one transverse crossing branch. Both branches marked is contradictory. No mark and equal depth is unresolved, not an arbitrary default.
contract.self_crossing: One event contains two distinct branches of the same strand; over_strand alone cannot identify the over branch.
contract.lift: Increase only marked crossing vertices by powers of two from the radii sum +1e-6 until all interstrand/nonadjacent segment pairs pass. Bounded failure is unresolved; not a universal embedding algorithm.
contract.model: Coarse cut-free cord seeds; output rest lengths are construction lengths. Never overwrite existing authored material rest lengths with a lifted route.
contract.reference: https://www.siam.org/publications/siam-news/articles/topological-knot-mechanics/ Figure3b for granny/reef; cropped lower throw for this half-knot boundary. Overhand cut from a (2,3) torus trefoil.
contract.scope: Exact rational segment intersection on input coordinates; angle/ray and distance calculations are binary64 numerical controls. Not a robust production predicate, generic knot classifier, or tight solve.

seed.scope: Cut-free construction only. Adjacent same-cord edges share their material neighborhood; every nonadjacent pair is checked for these coarse fixtures. No sweep from the intersecting planar drawing or smooth tube/curvature proof is claimed.
